record.paper: Inverse problems for minimal complements and maximal supplements

dossier_meta.paper: Inverse problems for minimal complements and maximal supplements
dossier_meta.statement_text: Is the behavior of $T(n)$ different when $n$ is prime? How much does $T(G)$ depend on the structure of $G$ in addition to the order of $G$?
dossier_meta.context_text: The best upper bound constructions for $T(n)$ rely on the existence of subgroups of certain orders, so the best known upper bound for $T(p)$ when $p$ is prime is only $O(p^{3/4+\varepsilon})$, which may not be tight.
